intent.raw: Define, design, and plan a private ontology and knowledge-graph learning application for CyberAlchemy Method, Craft, CyberAlchemy v2, and DomainSpec v2.
intent.objective: Produce a deterministic, source-preserving, non-collapsing private learning-map witness that compiles an explicitly candidate minted-project graph, independently consumes exact DomainSpec executable-evidence handles, and later rebinds the same normalized graph boundary to an owner-generated DomainSpec Sg.
intent.operator_sentence: Teach how concepts connect without turning the map into a new authority.

subagent_strategy.explanation: No subagent dispatch is authorized by this refresh. Each selected SWU remains one bounded local Task Session; the upstream support route and G-DSV2-SG continue through their governed owners.

boundaries.contract: The selected private-product owner governs projection fields and projection-local enums only. Authority-relevant discoveries are handed back to definitions governance and affected source owners without automatic promotion.
Candidate project, node, connection, graph, view, and build receipts remain explicitly non-authoritative and cannot satisfy G-DSV2-SG or claim release admission.

Only the exact owner-generated bounded FPR-04 Sg may supply DomainSpec admitted relations. The consumer verifies and imports it unchanged; it cannot reconstruct relations, alter FPR state, or promote projection evidence upstream.

boundaries.from_owner: EVF or BTE upstream evidence owner
boundaries.contract: IOLM accepts only exact fresh stage-specific handles under the private YAML contract, preserves IDs, relations, provenance, semantic bytes and view parity, emits an independent schema-valid receipt, and never authors or changes the upstream verdict. The EVF narrow receipt cannot satisfy the BTE breadth slot.

boundaries.from_owner: Arcanum/Craft, CAV2, and DomainSpec source owners
boundaries.contract: Other documentary sources may preserve and reference source-local meaning and learner anchors but cannot rewrite, promote, centralize, or reconstruct DomainSpec admitted relations.
Prototype writes stay under cyberAlchemy-v2/development/interactive-ontology-learning-map/prototype/ and never enter public arcanum/.

boundaries.to_owner: learner, navigation, layout, and UI builders
boundaries.contract: Learner, navigation, and layout changes cannot alter canonical semantic bytes, relations, or semanticHash.

boundaries.to_owner: future Arcanum-only projection and publication owners
boundaries.contract: No step builds, redacts, publishes, or claims safety for a public derivative.

authority.lifecycle: Invoke plan -> G-OWNER and G-POSTURE -> selected L0C Task Session -> independent L0D consumer Task Sessions only after exact upstream handles -> later independent G-DSV2-SG route for L0A -> one Task Session per selected SWU
authority.validation: task-local validators plus independent evidence task
authority.promotion: source-local owners, private-learning-map-product-owner for projection lifecycle, and an unresolved separate publication owner

receipts.producer: task-session verify over existing DomainSpec owner receipts
task-session under the private DomainSpec evidence-consumer contract

state_namespaces.owner: Arcanum/Craft, CAV2, or DomainSpec source owner
state_namespaces.write_policy: Projection tasks are read-only; no source-owned artifact is mutated.

state_namespaces.owner: DomainSpec FPR owners; read-only in this dispatch
state_namespaces.write_policy: The learning map binds and imports the exact Sg handle unchanged. It cannot reconstruct admitted relations, change FPR lifecycle, or use local success as DomainSpec acceptance.

Each selected consumer SWU writes only its declared prototype adapter, tests, and fresh run directory. Upstream evidence, verdict, profile, FPR, Craft, release, production, and publication state are read-only.
Projection fields and local enums may advance only under the recorded G-OWNER envelope; source-local values remain mandatory and authority-relevant discoveries require upstream handback.
Candidate sources and receipts may advance only inside selected prototype SWU scopes; they cannot claim DomainSpec authority or release admission.
Task Session writes only the current SWU scope under prototype/.

state_namespaces.owner: fixed fixture owner until an editorial owner is selected
state_namespaces.write_policy: Learning and navigation material cannot write semantic state.
No publication state or artifact is emitted by this dispatch.

promotion_splits.source: candidate projection build or pilot receipt
promotion_splits.target: G-DSV2-SG, source authority, promotion, production integration, or publication approval
promotion_splits.rule: Candidate evidence may inform separately owned decisions but never satisfies the authority gate or performs promotion itself.

promotion_splits.source: learning-map import, traversal, validation, or pilot receipt
promotion_splits.target: DomainSpec relation authority, FPR closure, profile selection, precedence, quotient/retraction semantics, or engine acceptance
promotion_splits.rule: Consumer evidence may report residue to the existing owner but cannot perform or imply any upstream promotion.

steps.name: Resolve projection contract owner
stop_conditions: block if no legitimate owner accepts the combined projection boundary
block if the decision attempts to take source-local semantic authority

steps.name: Resolve candidate-first execution posture
stop_conditions: block if no real option is selected
block if candidate evidence is allowed to satisfy G-DSV2-SG

steps.name: Lock candidate posture and provenance contract
stop_conditions: block if posture, provenance, source digest, compiler version, or stable identity is optional
block if a candidate receipt can satisfy G-DSV2-SG
stop after SWU-IOLM-00C-A; do not select 00C-B automatically

steps.name: Compile minimal deterministic candidate graph
stop_conditions: block if clean builds differ or any record lacks candidate provenance
stop unless SWU-IOLM-00C-B was explicitly selected after 00C-A review

steps.name: Prove shared candidate read-model parity
stop_conditions: block on graph, hierarchy, and table drift
block if candidate posture is missing from machine or visible views
stop unless SWU-IOLM-00C-C was explicitly selected after 00C-B review

steps.name: Consume exact EVF L0 proof in IOLM

inputs.ref: exact successful SWU-GCP-001 / evf-l0-core receipt handle

stop_conditions: block if the upstream stage, owner, freshness, digest, or required handle set is wrong
block on identity, direction, provenance, semantic, deterministic rebuild, parity, GET, negative, or write-scope failure
block if IOLM authors upstream evidence or changes any upstream verdict or authority state
stop after SWU-IOLM-DSC-A; do not select DSC-B automatically

steps.name: Rerun IOLM consumer proof over BTE breadth

inputs.ref: exact fresh green SWU-BTE-008 / bte-core receipt handle

stop_conditions: block unless stage=bte-core and exact 13-kind/16-signature denominator, test, execution, mutation, and digest checks pass
block narrow, stale, fixture-only, schema-only, self-authored, extra, duplicate, skipped, or surviving-mutant evidence
block if IOLM runs or closes BTE or changes any upstream verdict or authority state
return only the fresh breadth receipt handle to SWU-BTE-010

steps.name: Verify exact DomainSpec Sg readiness

inputs.ref: exact existing-owner receipts for the live retired-reference guard and FPR-01, FPR-02, FPR-03, and bounded FPR-04

stop_conditions: block if any guard or FPR receipt is absent, mismatched, or not owner-issued
block if Sg is missing, empty, schema-invalid, or identity-mismatched
block if quotient or independent retraction evidence is absent or any EGI-011 mutant passes
block if verification attempts to change FPR state or approve DomainSpec meaning

steps.name: Lock read-only import and projection contract
stop_conditions: block on any missing non-collapse fixture
block when manifest coverage is incomplete or not default-deny
block if the contract creates a local DomainSpec graph registry or permits relation reconstruction

steps.name: Build deterministic projection artifacts
stop_conditions: block if clean builds differ
block if learner, navigation, layout, or clock material changes semantic bytes
block if a feature table or local fixture reconstructs a DomainSpec admitted relation
block if imported Sg relation identity or provenance changes

steps.name: Compile typed ontology and Craft learning witnesses
stop_conditions: block if Sg is missing or empty, an unapproved local mapping enters semantic export, or the imported edge changes
block if any EGI-011 retraction mutant passes
block if a Craft analogy or philosophical claim is labeled as proof

steps.name: Expose bounded immutable queries
stop_conditions: block if any mutation route exists
block if a query can resolve an arbitrary filesystem path

steps.name: Build equivalent learning surfaces
stop_conditions: block on graph/hierarchy/table information drift
block when an essential graph action lacks a non-drag alternative

steps.name: Run evidence gates and bounded private pilot
stop_conditions: block any aggregate pass inferred from an unrun or failed independent gate
stop before production website mutation or public derivative work

gates.condition: PASS through work-pack/shared/G-OWNER-DECISION.md: the bounded private-product owner accepts the projection-only boundary and routes authority-relevant discoveries to their owners.
Candidate posture, provenance, stable identity, source digest, compiler version, and authority-guard negatives pass before compilation.
After separately selected SWUs, minted compilation is deterministic and graph, hierarchy, and table consume one candidate read model.

gates.owner: existing DomainSpec FPR owners for issuance; TASK-IOLM-000B for read-only verification
gates.condition: Before L0A authoritative labeling/rebind, exact FPR-01/02/03 receipts plus schema-valid bounded FPR-04 Sg, explicit quotient, and independent retraction are bound in domainspec-sg-readiness-handle.

After candidate substrate and successful evf-l0-core, SWU-IOLM-DSC-A emits a fresh schema-valid receipt with exact handles, unchanged identities/provenance, deterministic semantic/view parity, all required negatives rejected, and explicit non-admission.

After DSC-A and green bte-core, SWU-IOLM-DSC-B emits a distinct fresh schema-valid 13-kind/16-signature breadth receipt eligible for SWU-BTE-010; narrow, stale, fixture-only, schema-only, or self-authored evidence fails.
Schemas and fixtures preserve every non-collapse law and the source manifest is complete, pinned, and default-deny.
Repeated builds agree on canonical bytes, coordinates, indexes, hashes, and ETags while identity-bearing changes are detected.

gates.owner: source-local witness owners plus prototype evidence owner
gates.condition: Admitted, rejected, positive, and five-level claim fixtures preserve source-local posture and explicit residue.
Graph, hierarchy, and table expose equivalent records, relations, sources, states, challenges, and actions.

gates.owner: private prototype evidence and pilot owners
gates.condition: Technical, accessibility, performance, and comprehension gates return independent exact-scope receipts.
Private material and outputs remain outside public Arcanum, and no public readiness or publication is inferred.

promotion_guardrails: Internal planes and candidate axes are not canonical CAV2 kinds.
Projection is not promotion, production integration, or publication.
Document/schema evidence is not runtime correctness.
Renderer success is not accessibility conformance or comprehension.
A private build cannot be redacted into a public derivative.
A learning-map receipt cannot close an FPR node, approve a DomainSpec relation, select profile or precedence, define quotient or retraction, or certify engine acceptance.
Candidate graph, conformance, and parity receipts cannot satisfy G-DSV2-SG.
Candidate and authoritative inputs share one normalized read model and do not fork the UI pipeline.
DomainSpec admitted relations come only from the exact owner-generated Sg and are imported unchanged.
IOLM consumer receipts cannot define predicates or obligations, author upstream handles, select a profile, change an upstream verdict, or substitute a narrow receipt for BTE breadth.
No task writes private content into arcanum/.
